objective_source: card says: fine-tuned using the approach configurable safety tuning (CST). Paper says: CST augments DPO and resorts to using the same DPO loss function over tuples (s0, x, y0, y1) and (s1, x, y1, y0). https://arxiv.org/html/2404.00495. Script uses DPOTrainer but hardcodes teknium/OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B. The dataset tag dpo is not the evidence.

Hermes 3 siblings are four full safetensors shards and no adapter_config.json.
data_provenance: synthetic. Dataset card: safety half is self-critique on Harmful Behaviours using the SOLAR-Instruct model; other half is jondurbin/truthy-dpo-v0.1. Generator of the truthy-dpo half is not stated on this dataset card.
evaluation_reported: not stated for this checkpoint. Paper tables are OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B + CST (S1 1.00, S0 1.00) and SOLAR-Instruct-10.7B + CST.
detects: does not classify. Writes a chat reply. System prompt can request a harmless refusal-style assistant, an uncensored assistant, or a harmful assistant. Hand classification chat reply, prompt-controlled refusal: agree.
